narrative.overview: A quiet warm-paper work surface where reading remains comfortable and remote state remains immediately actionable. Personality comes from typography, rhythm, and restrained terracotta action cues rather than effects.
keyCharacteristics: State expressed by icon, text, and tone

rules.name: The Rare Terracotta Rule
rules.body: Terracotta marks the current action or the single next action; it is not decoration.

rules.name: The No Green Status Rule
rules.body: Online and completed states use text, icon, and neutral tone rather than a green status system.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Use paper tones and spacing before elevation effects.

dos: Do make connection, run, and stop state readable in a 300ms glance.
Do keep all interactive hit targets at least 44px.
Do drive terminal states from authoritative host events.
donts: Don't use glass, gradients, green status styling, black docks, or offset color shadows.
Don't stack generic rounded cards and pills.
Don't claim a task stopped because a local timer expired.
